summary: GOWell Energy Technology filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 7, 2026, announcing a First Half 2026 Financial Results Corporate Update Webinar scheduled for October 21, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET, featuring CEO Guillaume Borrel, CFO Mike Reed and VP Corporate Development David MacNeill. No transaction, stake, price or board recommendation is disclosed. The release notes the prior completion of the Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. V business combination on September 25, 2026 and Nasdaq trading under GOW as of September 28, 2026, both historical. No special-situation event; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
